entities.summary: Joel Alf Ivar Gistedt is a former professional Swedish ice hockey goaltender. He last played for Kristianstads IK in the HockeyAllsvenskan (Allsv). Gistedt was selected by the Phoenix Coyotes in the 2nd round of the 2007 NHL Entry Draft whilst playing as a youth in Frölunda HC organization.
